Fatima Shah
Senior QA Automation Engineer | Thane West
fatima.shah428@example.com | +91 9580569112

Senior QA Automation Engineer with a strong focus on API and UI test automation, CI/CD integration, and stability improvements across payments and SaaS platforms. Proven record of reducing defect leakage, accelerating release cycles, and building reusable test frameworks. Open to relocation anywhere in India. 60 days notice period.

Experience

Senior QA Automation Engineer — Remote/Onsite
- Built and maintained Postman collections and automated API regression suites that reduced manual API test time by 70% and caught 35% more critical issues pre-release.
- Integrated Postman-run collections into Jenkins pipelines to enable automated smoke and nightly regression runs, improving CI feedback loop from 4 hours to under 45 minutes.
- Led Test Automation efforts for merchant onboarding flows, writing Java-based helpers and Selenium wrappers for cross-browser checks, contributing to a 25% reduction in post-deploy incidents.

NimbusSoft, Nov 2021 - Apr 2023
Test Engineer — Hybrid
- Designed and executed Postman-driven API tests for microservices, resulting in early detection of schema and auth regressions and a 40% drop in production API errors.
- Developed and maintained Java test utilities and Jenkins jobs to orchestrate end-to-end test runs, reducing flaky runs by 30% through stabilization and retry strategies.
- Coordinated with product and engineering in Agile ceremonies and used Jira to track and triage defects, improving bug resolution SLA by 20%.

Cognizant, Jan 2018 - Oct 2021
QA Automation Engineer — Onsite
- Implemented Selenium WebDriver-based UI automation frameworks in Java covering core enterprise workflows, increasing automated UI coverage to 60% of critical paths.
- Integrated automated suites with Jenkins to run parallel test jobs and generate CI reports, decreasing deployment verification time by 50%.
- Drove Test Automation initiatives including data-driven test design and reusable page objects, and collaborated in Agile teams to reduce regression cycle time.

CartNest, Apr 2015 - Dec 2017
QA Automation Engineer — Onsite
- Developed Java-based automation frameworks for e-commerce web applications using Selenium, improving test repeatability and reducing manual regression effort by 55%.
- Created Jenkins pipelines for scheduled and pre-release automation runs and configured Postman suites for API validation of checkout and catalog services.
- Participated in Sprint planning and used Jira to log and manage defects, contributing to improved sprint quality and fewer production hotfixes.

Projects
- Payment Gateway Regression Suite: Architected and maintained combined Postman and Selenium regression suite integrated into Jenkins for nightly runs; decreased merchant-impacting incidents by 30%.
- Cross-Browser Stabilization Effort: Led flakiness triage and added retry & wait strategies to Selenium Java tests, lowering false positives by 40% across Chrome and Firefox runs.
